query:
SELECT ln.leadId, l.name, ln.text, ln.authorName, ln.timestamp
FROM lead_notes ln
JOIN leads l ON l.id = ln.leadId
WHERE l.id IN (
  '8eXxdH9S-tZKSjM0v3Kml',
  'GaibNN5qq0p1x9cwlgG9f',
  'MW959ff-YUx7IMK3bGHBm',
  'Z4BVicKvWcJjh1fe3J0Yp',
  'h6VWli-cup9mEdSsxKCZS',
  'r6Fhbms_Mwn5mwxmlS_KE',
  'xaWqfnS6ZBTRCnChX0mBj',
  'YYMxuSI3XIJjIxApl1MRd',

rows.text: Client is our previous client and currently has a pending asylum case with our office. Client reports that on the night of May 31, 2026, he was attacked by four unknown individuals at a friend's house. He sustained a head injury requiring three stitches and was treated at San Joaquin General Hospital. Medical records document assault-related injuries, including a head laceration, closed head injury, and loss of consciousness (LOC). Photographs of the injuries are available.  Client filed a police report (Report No. 26-02562). Detectives are actively investigating the incident and have reportedly collected statements from other victims/witnesses. Client also received a Marsy's Card from the San Joaquin County District Attorney's Office.  Police report is expected next week. Once received, client will schedule an attorney consultation ($150) for further evaluation of potential U-Visa eligibility and law enforcement certification prospects while considering the impact on his pending asylum case.
